test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statement.

**Statement:** India’s largest lender bank has announced that it will be allowing customers to exchange ₹2,000 notes without a requisition slip for amounts up to ₹20,000.

**Conclusions:**

I. No one will be allowed to withdraw an amount of more than ₹20,000.

II. No requisition slip is required for exchange of up to ₹20,000.

options.text: Both Conclusion I and Conclusion II follow
Neither Conclusion I nor Conclusion II follows

solution:
The statement mentions that no requisition slip is required to exchange ₹2,000 notes for amounts up to ₹20,000. Hence, **Conclusion II follows.**

There is no information regarding the withdrawal of more than ₹20,000. So, it can't be said that whether it is allowed or not. Hence, **Conclusion I don't follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only Conclusion II follows"**.
